name: LA Fitness S. Lamar

plans.name: Basic (Club of Enrollment)
plans.note: Access to the club of enrollment only. Annual fee is billed 14 days after enrollment and every year thereafter. Last month's dues are collected upfront alongside the first month.

plans.name: Signature (Multi Club, State of Enrollment)
plans.note: Includes Pilates by LA Fitness, Studio Group Training and The Glute Room.

plans.name: Classic (Nationwide Access)
plans.note: Access to all LA Fitness and City Sports Clubs nationwide.

plans.name: Classic (Nationwide Access, no initiation)
plans.note: Same nationwide access with no initiation fee, at a higher monthly rate.

pricing_note: No initial term — all plans auto-renew with no commitment. Prices exclude tax. LA Fitness states prices may vary by location or change without notice.
